content.text:
For today (investor pitch), here’s a tight structure you can execute quickly, plus what to prep to support the Series C push this week.

## Investor pitch: fastest high-signal outline (10–12 slides)
1) **Title / One-liner**: CloudScale simplifies cloud deployments (and why now).
2) **Problem**: What’s broken for your target buyer today (pain, cost, speed, complexity).
3) **Solution**: What CloudScale uniquely does; 2–3 key capabilities.
4) **Why you win**: Differentiators (tech moat, distribution, switching costs, data/infra advantage).
5) **Product**: Quick demo narrative or screenshots; include **Project Phoenix** as the next growth engine.
6) **Market**: ICP + TAM/SAM/SOM (keep it credible and bottom-up if possible).
7) **Traction**: Revenue, growth, retention, usage, key logos, expansion motion (even if anonymized).
8) **Business model**: Pricing + unit economics snapshot (gross margin, payback, NRR if you have it).
9) **Go-to-market**: How you acquire/expand; what you’ll scale with Series C.
10) **Team**: Why this team can win (include you + Sarah + key eng strength).
11) **Financials**: Current run-rate + next 6–8 quarters headline; what drives growth.
12) **The ask**: Amount, use of funds, milestones to next round/exit.

## What I need from you to tailor it in one pass
- Funding ask range (e.g., $XM), and runway target
- 3 strongest traction metrics you can share (ARR, growth %, NRR, logo count, usage, etc.)
- Your core ICP (who buys, who uses)
- The 2–3 biggest competitive threats you’ll get asked about

## This week (hiring + closing Series C): quick execution checklist
- **Close plan**: target investor list, warm intro paths, meeting calendar, data room readiness, timeline.
- **Narrative alignment**: one consistent story across you + Sarah (product) + Dave (delivery credibility).
- **Hiring priorities**: 2–3 roles that unlock growth (e.g., GTM leader, platform eng, SRE, product).

If you paste your current pitch outline (even rough) or slide titles, I’ll rewrite it into a crisp Series C narrative and suggest exactly what to cut/add.
